title: Cech complex and Cech cohomology of a presheaf for a family in the small etale site
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, let $X_{\Et}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $\mathcal U=\{f_i:U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ be a family of morphisms of $X_{\Et}$ with fixed target $U$ (for instance a covering of $X_{\Et}$, finite or not; all fibre products $U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}$ exist in $X_{\Et}$). Let $\mathcal F$ be a presheaf of abelian groups on $X_{\Et}$. The *Cech complex* $\check{\mathcal C}^\bullet(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$ has in degree $p\geq0$ the abelian group $\check{\mathcal C}^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)=\prod_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in I^{p+1}}\mathcal F(U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p})$ and differential $d:\check{\mathcal C}^p\to\check{\mathcal C}^{p+1}$, $d(s)_{i_0\ldots i_{p+1}}=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^js_{i_0\ldots\hat{i_j}\ldots i_{p+1}}|_{U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_{p+1}}}$, the restriction being along the projection omitting the $j$-th factor; $d\circ d=0$. Its cohomology groups $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)=H^p(\check{\mathcal C}^\bullet(\mathcal U,\mathcal F))$ are the *Cech cohomology groups* of $\mathcal F$ for $\mathcal U$. The construction is functorial and exact in $\mathcal F$ (each term is a product of evaluations). For a presheaf or sheaf of modules (e.g. an object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},R)$) the Cech complex is by definition that of its underlying presheaf of abelian groups. (For finite coverings and module sheaves this is the complex of [def-weil-pbc-cover-cech].)

cechComplexFunctor U = FormalCoproduct.cochainComplexFunctor (FormalCoproduct.mk _ U).cech: degree n is the product over x : Fin (n+1) → ι of P(∏_a U (x a)), differential the alternating sum of the cofaces of the Cech nerve, whose j-th face omits the j-th index (mapPower along δ_j); only file using it
